 Sunteck Realty Q2 Profit Jumps 17%, Income Up 27%
 By Rediff Money Desk , New Delhi 
 1 Minute Read Listen to Article 
 Share:     
 Oct 27, 2026 10:35
 x 
 Sunteck Realty reports strong Q2 2026-27 results with net profit rising 17% to Rs 57 cr and total income growing 27% to Rs 334 cr. Pre-sales also increased. Key Points
 Sunteck Realty's consolidated net profit rose 17% to Rs 57.11 crore in the September quarter.
 Total income for the July-September quarter increased 27% to Rs 333.82 crore.
 Pre-sales grew 17% to Rs 824 crore in Q2 and 19% to Rs 1,611 crore in the first half.
 For the first half of the fiscal, net profit reached Rs 99.07 crore and total income was Rs 535.85 crore.
 New Delhi, Oct 27 (PTI) Sunteck Realty Ltd has reported a 17 per cent increase in its consolidated net profit to Rs 57.11 crore in the quarter ended September on higher income. 
 Its net profit stood at Rs 48.96 crore in the year-ago period. 
 Total income rose 27 per cent to Rs 333.82 crore during the July-September quarter of 2026-27 fiscal from Rs 262.16 crore in the corresponding period of the preceding year, according to a regulatory filing on Monday. 
 In the first half of this fiscal, the company's net profit rose to Rs 99.07 crore from Rs 82.39 crore in the year-ago period. 
 During April-September period of 2026-27, the company's total income grew to Rs 535.85 crore from Rs 463.69 crore in the year-ago period. 
 On the operational front, Sunteck Realty reported that its pre-sales grew 17 per cent to Rs 824 crore in September quarter and 19 per cent in the first six months to Rs 1,611 crore.
 Mumbai-based Sunteck Realty is one of the leading real estate developers in the country. It has a portfolio of over 50 million sq ft area across 32 projects. -->
